```{r global-options, include=FALSE}
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("NAVCITY_CODE"), "setup.R"), local = TRUE)   # data paths, sample filter, fixes
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r load-data}
# Load OA and YA navigation data
oa_data <- read_csv(file.path(navcity_path, "oa_merged_results.csv"))
oa_data$Age_Group <- "OA"
oa_data <- oa_data %>% select(-1)

ya_data <- read_csv(file.path(navcity_path, "ya_merged_results.csv"))
ya_data$Age_Group <- "YA"
ya_data <- ya_data %>% select(-1)

# Load non-navigation data to get NARA scores
non_nav_data <- read_csv(file.path(paper_data_path, "non_nav_data.csv"))

# Build NARA subgroups
oa_nara <- non_nav_data %>%
  filter(Group == "OA") %>%
  select(Participant, NARA) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NARA))

nara_cutoff <- 3.5
oa_groups <- oa_nara %>%
  mutate(OA_Subgroup = ifelse(NARA >= nara_cutoff, "OA_High", "OA_Low"))

cat("OA subgroup distribution:\n")
print(table(oa_groups$OA_Subgroup))

# Merge NARA subgroups back into OA navigation data
oa_data <- oa_data %>%
  left_join(oa_groups %>% select(Participant, OA_Subgroup), by = "Participant") %>%
  mutate(
    Age_Group = case_when(
      is.na(OA_Subgroup) ~ "OA",
      TRUE ~ OA_Subgroup
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-OA_Subgroup)

# Combine YA + OA (with subgroups) into one dataset
nav_data <- bind_rows(oa_data, ya_data)

# Set factor levels: YA as reference, then OA_High, then OA_Low
nav_data$Age_Group <- factor(nav_data$Age_Group, levels = c("YA", "OA_High", "OA_Low"))
nav_data$Block_Num <- factor(nav_data$Block_Num,
                             levels = c("1", "2", "3"),
                             labels = c("Block1", "Block2", "Block3"))

cat("Age_Group levels:", levels(nav_data$Age_Group), "\n")
cat("Total observations:", nrow(nav_data), "\n")
print(table(nav_data$Age_Group, nav_data$Block_Num))
```

# Step 1: Identify the OA_High outlier on mean teleport distance

Panel C in Fig. 6 shows each participant's mean teleport distance averaged across blocks. We compute this per-participant mean and inspect the OA_High group for outliers using two methods: (1) visual/lowest-separated and (2) IQR.

```{r identify-outlier}
# Compute per-participant mean teleport distance (averaged across blocks/targets)
participant_means <- nav_data %>%
  group_by(Participant, Age_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Teleport_Distance_avg = mean(Mean_Teleport_Distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Age_Group, Mean_Teleport_Distance_avg)

# Show the lowest 5 OA_High participants
cat("\n=== OA_High participants: 5 lowest mean teleport distances ===\n")
participant_means %>%
  filter(Age_Group == "OA_High") %>%
  arrange(Mean_Teleport_Distance_avg) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  print()

# IQR-based outlier detection within OA_High
oa_high_vals <- participant_means %>%
  filter(Age_Group == "OA_High") %>%
  pull(Mean_Teleport_Distance_avg)

q1 <- quantile(oa_high_vals, 0.25)
q3 <- quantile(oa_high_vals, 0.75)
iqr <- q3 - q1
lower_fence <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
upper_fence <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr

cat("\n=== OA_High IQR-based outlier fences ===\n")
cat("Q1:", round(q1, 3), " Q3:", round(q3, 3), " IQR:", round(iqr, 3), "\n")
cat("Lower fence (Q1 - 1.5*IQR):", round(lower_fence, 3), "\n")
cat("Upper fence (Q3 + 1.5*IQR):", round(upper_fence, 3), "\n")

iqr_outliers <- participant_means %>%
  filter(Age_Group == "OA_High",
         Mean_Teleport_Distance_avg < lower_fence |
         Mean_Teleport_Distance_avg > upper_fence)

cat("\nIQR-based outliers in OA_High:\n")
print(iqr_outliers)

# Visual/lowest-separated outlier: the single lowest value
lowest_participant <- participant_means %>%
  filter(Age_Group == "OA_High") %>%
  arrange(Mean_Teleport_Distance_avg) %>%
  slice(1)

cat("\n=== Single lowest OA_High participant (visual outlier) ===\n")
print(lowest_participant)

# Define the outlier to remove (we will use the single lowest; adjust if IQR disagrees)
outlier_participant <- lowest_participant$Participant
cat("\nParticipant flagged for removal:", outlier_participant, "\n")
```

# Step 2: Run the LMM on teleport distance — full dataset (with outlier)

```{r full-analysis}
# Mixed model: Teleport distance ~ Age_Group (3 levels) * Block + random intercepts
m_full <- lmer(Mean_Teleport_Distance ~ Age_Group * Block_Num +
                 (1|Target_Name) + (1|Participant),
               data = nav_data)

cat("\n=== FULL MODEL: ANOVA ===\n")
print(anova(m_full))

# Overall (across-blocks) pairwise comparisons between age groups
emm_age_full <- emmeans(m_full, ~ Age_Group)
contrasts_age_full <- summary(pairs(emm_age_full, adjust = "fdr"), infer = TRUE)
cat("\n=== FULL MODEL: Age-group pairwise contrasts (FDR-adjusted) ===\n")
print(contrasts_age_full)

# Block-specific pairwise comparisons between age groups
emm_interaction_full <- emmeans(m_full, ~ Age_Group * Block_Num)
contrasts_age_within_block_full <- summary(
  pairs(emm_interaction_full, simple = "Age_Group", adjust = "fdr"),
  infer = TRUE
)
cat("\n=== FULL MODEL: Age-group contrasts within each block (FDR) ===\n")
print(contrasts_age_within_block_full)
```

# Step 3: Run the LMM on teleport distance — WITHOUT the outlier

```{r sensitivity-analysis}
nav_data_no_outlier <- nav_data %>%
  filter(Participant != outlier_participant)

cat("\nSample size check after outlier removal:\n")
print(table(nav_data_no_outlier$Age_Group, nav_data_no_outlier$Block_Num))

m_sens <- lmer(Mean_Teleport_Distance ~ Age_Group * Block_Num +
                 (1|Target_Name) + (1|Participant),
               data = nav_data_no_outlier)

cat("\n=== SENSITIVITY MODEL (outlier removed): ANOVA ===\n")
print(anova(m_sens))

emm_age_sens <- emmeans(m_sens, ~ Age_Group)
contrasts_age_sens <- summary(pairs(emm_age_sens, adjust = "fdr"), infer = TRUE)
cat("\n=== SENSITIVITY MODEL: Age-group pairwise contrasts (FDR) ===\n")
print(contrasts_age_sens)

emm_interaction_sens <- emmeans(m_sens, ~ Age_Group * Block_Num)
contrasts_age_within_block_sens <- summary(
  pairs(emm_interaction_sens, simple = "Age_Group", adjust = "fdr"),
  infer = TRUE
)
cat("\n=== SENSITIVITY MODEL: Age-group contrasts within each block (FDR) ===\n")
print(contrasts_age_within_block_sens)
```

# Step 4: Side-by-side comparison

```{r comparison-table}
# Format and tag both full + sensitivity results, then combine
tag_results <- function(df, label) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Analysis = label) %>%
    select(Analysis, everything())
}

overall_compare <- bind_rows(
  tag_results(as.data.frame(contrasts_age_full), "Full (with outlier)"),
  tag_results(as.data.frame(contrasts_age_sens), "Sensitivity (outlier removed)")
)

within_block_compare <- bind_rows(
  tag_results(as.data.frame(contrasts_age_within_block_full), "Full (with outlier)"),
  tag_results(as.data.frame(contrasts_age_within_block_sens), "Sensitivity (outlier removed)")
)

cat("\n=== SIDE-BY-SIDE: Overall age-group contrasts ===\n")
print(overall_compare)

cat("\n=== SIDE-BY-SIDE: Age-group contrasts within each block ===\n")
print(within_block_compare)
```

# Step 5: Save results (non-conflicting filenames)

```{r save-results}
write.csv(overall_compare,
          "sensitivity_teleport_dist_overall_contrasts.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(within_block_compare,
          "sensitivity_teleport_dist_within_block_contrasts.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(participant_means %>% filter(Age_Group == "OA_High"),
          "sensitivity_teleport_dist_oa_high_participant_means.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nSaved:\n")
cat("  sensitivity_teleport_dist_overall_contrasts.csv\n")
cat("  sensitivity_teleport_dist_within_block_contrasts.csv\n")
cat("  sensitivity_teleport_dist_oa_high_participant_means.csv\n")
```
